description: Canonical Peano arithmetic axioms. Immutable once frozen. All arithmetic operations in the system must be reducible to these axioms.

axioms.name: Successor
axioms.statement: For every natural number n, S(n) is a natural number.

axioms.name: Zero not successor
axioms.statement: For no natural number n is S(n) = 0.

axioms.name: Successor injective
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n, if S(m) = S(n) then m = n.

axioms.name: Induction
axioms.statement: If P(0) is true and for every natural number n, P(n) implies P(S(n)), then P holds for all natural numbers.

axioms.name: Addition base
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers n, n + 0 = n.

axioms.name: Addition step
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n, m + S(n) = S(m + n).

axioms.name: Multiplication base
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers n, n * 0 = 0.

axioms.name: Multiplication step
axioms.statement: For all natural numbers m, n, m * S(n) = (m * n) + m.
